data.name: Spells
data.description: A vox adds the following spells to his class list: 1st-ear-piercing scream; 2nd-cacophonous call, disrupt silence, distracting cacophony, piercing shriek, sonic scream; 4th-shout, sonic thrust, wall of sound; 5th-cacophonous call (mass), echolocation, resonating word; 6th-magnifying chime, shout (greater), sonic form. Unlike most psychic spells, a vox's mesmerist spells use both thought and verbal components; like a bard, a vox cannot remove the verbal components of his spells. This alters the mesmerist's spellcasting.
